system.description:
No longer confined to your body, you project your senses and awareness onto the planes of thought, roaming as an incorporeal spirit. Untethered by mass, you pass through any barrier and travel at the speed of thought to anywhere on Earth beneath the moon, spying as a formless observer while your body lies comatose. A silver cord tethers your spirit to your flesh.

Sending your senses out costs a Willpower Trait; you may remain out as long as you like, though sunrise over your body may force you into slumber. You are invisible and intangible — immune to conventional harm, though your comatose body remains vulnerable — but sense your surroundings normally and may use your other Auspex powers. Spending a second Willpower Trait lets you manifest for one turn as a visible, audible apparition, able to use Mental or Social Disciplines by expending a Mental Trait. You may converse with and use Disciplines on other astral travellers, or attack their silver cord: astral combat uses Mental Challenges and inflicts Willpower loss, and a traveller reduced to no Willpower has his cord snapped, stranding him in the spirit realms. You cannot possess bodies while astral, nor perceive wraiths, Umbral spirits or Garou unless you find a way into their worlds.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
system.duration: Until you return to your body
